products.title: KAJAL V Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
KAJAL V is a 100 ml eau de parfum with a warm gourmand-woody character, created by perfumer Sidonie Grandperret. Roasted nuts, aromatic tobacco leaves and indulgent pastry open the fragrance, leading to rose, honey, leather and oud. Tonka bean, Peru balsam and white musk form a creamy, velvety base. A fragrance of warmth and depth, KAJAL V celebrates transformation and discovery.

KAJAL V, a symbol of transformation, freedom, and the journey of discovery, embodied in the timeless form of the Roman numeral V. It marks a pivotal moment of change, where challenges become opportunities and faith becomes the force that guides us toward growth. KAJAL V celebrates the beauty of transformation through perseverance and belief.

More than a fragrance, KAJAL V is an invitation to trust the journey, embrace change, and discover the extraordinary possibilities that emerge when faith leads the way. It is a tribute to transformation, a reminder that every ending holds the promise of a new beginning.

Created by Burgundy-born perfumer Sidonie Grandperret, the composition traces Layal’s journey, unfolding with succulent notes of roasted nuts, aromatic tobacco leaves and warm, indulgent pastry.

At its heart, vibrant rose intertwines with golden honey, supple leather and precious oud, before settling into a sumptuous base of creamy tonka bean, Peru balsam and velvety white musk.

An exquisite olfactory trail of understated elegance and unforgettable allure.

products.title: The Kajal Discovery Collection
products.body_html:
Enter the world of Kajal Perfumes Paris through a curated collection of 10 x 3ml fragrance vials, each revealing a distinctive facet of the Maison’s rich olfactory universe.

From luminous freshness and irresistible gourmand notes to precious woods, sensual florals and captivating accords, this elegant collection invites you to experience the artistry, emotion and individuality behind Kajal’s celebrated creations.

Thoughtfully curated for exploration, each fragrance offers an opportunity to discover the scent that resonates most deeply with you.

products.title: Dahab Absolu Extrait de Parfum 100ml
products.body_html:
At the center lies gold in its purest form, warm, fluid, alive. When it moves, it expands in perfect circles, shaping everything it touches.Dahab Absolu is that moment when what lives within radiates out-ward, becoming presence, where gold becomes energy.

Like gold radiating from its source, the fragrance unfolds in quiet waves - on the body, in the air, within the self. What remains is not a trace, but an aura: intimate, enduring, quietly powerful.This is gold at its origin - concentrated, radiant, infinite in reach. Dahab Absolu returns to the origin of gold, its core. More than a continuation, it is the moment from which Dahab is born.

Bright citrus and lush tropical fruits spark the opening with light and vitality, where bergamot and grapefruit meet juicy orange, green ap-ple, passion fruit, mango, and sun-ripened tropical fruits in a vibrant, mouthwatering burst.

At its heart, jasmine and rose bloom with instinctive softness, wrapped in golden honey and softened by geranium, lily of the valley, and the green nuance of blackcurrant leaves, unfolding like a memory you can feel.As it settles, musk and vanilla melt into a warm, textured base of woods, where moss, caramel, guaiac wood, and cashmere wood intertwine, creating a smooth, ambered glow that lingers on skin, in the air, and within the self.

DAHAB ABSOLU is not worn to be noticed,

It is worn to be felt.

products.title: The Whispering Oud Extrait de Parfum 30 ml
products.body_html:
The Whispering Oud by Kajal is a 30 ml extrait de parfum with a rich, woody scent profile. Oud meets rose, leather and honey, with dried fruits, tobacco leaves, tonka bean and white musk adding layers of sweetness, warmth and depth. Its dark, opulent character echoes the mystery of Layal’s journey through the Crimson Forest.

 

Beneath the canopy of the Crimson Forest, silence is never empty. As Layal flees under a moonless sky, the path ahead draws her into a forgotten world - one laced with ancient power and fragrant with secrets. A place where time holds its breath, and every step tests her resolve. Whispers of her mother’s legacy echo through the darkness, guiding her toward a destiny only she can fulfil. The first elixir awaits, but its guardian does not yield easily. Deep within the hush of the forest, something - or someone - is watching…

products.title: Lamar Caviar Perfume D'Eau 30 ml
products.body_html:
Lamar Caviar by Kajal is a 30 ml ethanol-free, water-based fine fragrance created by master perfumer Mark Buxton. Fragrance oil is encapsulated in alginate perfume pearls, preserving the scent until dispensing. The capsules break upon application to release a fine mist, offering a distinctive way to experience fragrance.

When we venture into the tantalizing lure of the unknown, we reveal the profound beauty of life’s infinite possibilities. Immersed in the mesmerizing depths of tropical lagoons, bathed in the luminous glow of sunlight cascading through the undulating waters, some of nature’s rarest treasures lie waiting to be unveiled, timelessly elegant, lustrous, Golden Pearls.

Lamar Caviar by Kajal is the first ever ethanol-free fine fragrance to harness the innovation of Microcaps’ patented “perfume-pearls” technology, which introduces unique features that will redefine the future fine fragrance industry for both brands and consumers.

Kajal, Microcaps AG and LUZI AG have collaborated to create Lamar Caviar by Kajal. This precious, water- based fragrance oil is encapsulated within alginate pearls, preserving the scent until it is dispensed. Upon application, the alginate capsules break, releasing a magnificent mist of luxurious Lamar Caviar by Kajal.

The revolutionary appearance of Lamar Caviar encapsulates each of these definitions as much as the fragrance itself, a wonderfully opulent celebration of exoticism which was exquisitely created by master perfumer Mark Buxton, to resemble the radiant beauty and warmth of a golden sun setting on the horizon. Lamar Caviar exudes an irresistible mystique, a truly bewitching symphony of extravagant elegance.

Natural.
Sustainable.
Cruelty Free.
Vegan.

products.title: Kajal I Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Kajal I is a 100 ml eau de parfum blending fresh cassis, ruby-red grapefruit and mandarin with a woody, spicy heart. Guaiac wood, cardamom, orange blossom and cashmeran lead into oud, musk, patchouli, sandalwood, tonka beans and vanilla. Inspired by new beginnings and individuality, it balances zesty brightness with a warm woody finish.

Every beginning is a gift of unsurpassable value, the unspoken promise of boundless potential. Although the pathway we have travelled on may have been dark, unclear, or tumultuous at times, we can choose to change our direction and follow an illuminated trail of optimism. The past may be indelible, but it does not define us. We are shaped by our will and determination to improve ourselves with every passing day.  

Spiritually, number one represents beginnings, focus and determination. It embodies the essence of individuality and ignites a journey of self-discovery and empowerment. 

Kajal l has been crafted for those who exude sincerity and stand with unwavering dignity and grace. An essence that epitomizes the irresistible appeal of authentic charisma.  

Invigorating top notes of cassis, ruby-red grapefruits, and mandarin, deliver a fresh and zesty introduction. Its heart reveals a woody embrace, featuring guaiac wood, cardamom, orange blossom, and cashmeran, combining depth and elegance. The base notes reveal a symphony of oud, musk, patchouli, sandalwood, tonka beans, and vanilla, creating a lasting and alluring impression.

products.title: Kajal II Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Kajal II is a 100 ml eau de parfum combining mandarin, bergamot, lemon and green notes with orange blossom and amber. Peach, lavender, rosemary and sage meet cinnamon, cloves and cedarwood at the heart. Sandalwood, oakmoss, patchouli, musk, woody and sweet notes form the base, balancing citrus brightness with aromatic spice and woody depth.

Life is sustained by balance, both physically and spiritually, throughout our lives we often find ourselves reflecting upon the dual aspects of our experiences and the dual elements within ourselves. When we embrace duality, we embrace serenity, for only when we accept the contrasting counterparts within and around us do we achieve stability. 

Spiritually, number two symbolizes balance, unity and harmony, a reminder that we are all connected. When we bring together the contrasting elements of our very core and the experiences we face, a profound equilibrium emerges within us. This harmony not only strengthens our inner self but radiates outward, emphasizing the vital role our connections with others hold in shaping our existence. 

 

Kajal II is a tribute to these magnificent qualities, meticulously designed to enhance your allure, magnetism, and individuality.

products.title: Kajal Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Veiled in understated allure and seductive whispers, Kajal draws inspiration from 'Khajal', an Arabic term signifying modesty and self-awareness, highly esteemed across Arab cultures for its profound respectfulness. By welcoming others with respect, regardless of their journey, we reflect our own integrity and acknowledge the inherent dignity that exists in every soul.

The essence of our true spirit is often illuminated by the magnetic allure of our eyes. Captivatingly beautiful, eyes that radiate kindness, sincerity, and compassion highlight the luminous purity of a virtuous heart.

Kajal opens with the refreshing vibrancy of Amalfi lemon, mandarin, and bergamot, renowned for their ability to enhance spiritual awareness.

As the heart notes unfurl, Turkish Rose makes a graceful debut, gradually blossoming into a rich, velvety embrace, complemented by the luxurious softness of orris.

The base notes settle into an intoxicatingly warm, sensual embrace of musk, amber, Madagascan vanilla, tonka beans, and a hint of Mysore sandalwood, cherished for its ability to promote a sense of serenity.

products.title: Dahab by Kajal Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Dahab Eau de Parfum by Kajal is a 100 ml fragrance with a fruity, spicy and woody scent profile. Granny Smith apple and bergamot bring a fresh opening, with passion fruit, coriander and cedar adding depth over a base of patchouli, musk and amber. Inspired by the radiance of gold, Dahab balances bright fruit with warm woods.

Dahab is the Arabic name for gold, worshipped by ancient civilizations who associated gold with the sun due to its captivating radiance. Gold’s beguiling allure has never waned over time, to this day it is treasured and desired for its miraculous beauty. 

Pure gold will never tarnish, indestructible yet resilient, its brilliance never fades. Known to enhance feelings of serenity and positivity, gold represents the highest stages of spiritual enlightenment. 

Since the dawn of time, gold has inspired imagination and fueled creativity. The cap of Dahab is an eight-point star, a symbol of life. Stars gave life to gold, and the eight different names for forms of gold are engraved upon the cap in beautiful, Arabic calligraphy. 

Created by renowned perfumers Christian Carbonnel & Rosendo Mateu, Dahab emanates feelings of luxurious richness combined with exotic mysticism.

products.title: Joorie by Kajal Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Joorie by Kajal is a 100 ml eau de parfum centred on rose, warm spices and a honeyed woody base. Nutmeg and clove open with lemon, bergamot, ginger and pepper, leading to rose, ylang-ylang and orange blossom. Honey, musk, tonka beans, sandalwood and cedar give a rich finish, evoking the velvety red roses of a summer garden.

Joorie is our red rose in all its aspects of love – caring and confident.

Joorie is our red rose reflecting strength – supportive and dependable.

Joorie is our red rose in all its splendour – marvellous and beautiful.

 

"In working on the creation of Joorie, I kept having flashbacks to the farmhouse where my family would go during our summer holidays. There were two acres of land surrounding the little house, fenced with pine trees along the borders. Berries, figs, jasmines, petunias, chamomiles, and lavender were just a few of the many plants that we had growing in the gardens. Most majestic of all was the one rose bush that yielded the most beautiful red flowers, and it was this plant that I would visit on a daily basis – not only to see the sublime velvety red petals and superior elegance of the roses, but also to capture a whiff of the sensual perfume that this rose would so elegantly emit." - Moe Khalaf (Founder & Kajal Creative Officer).

This was the main inspiration behind the scent of Joorie. Working with Drom’s perfumer, Alix Miral, a masterpiece was created.

An inviting and warm nutmeg/clove note creates the opening scent of Joorie. Lemon and bergamot add a zest of freshness to the scent – traces of ginger and pepper linger not far behind.

The heart of the fragrance is rose infused with the fruity, almost banana-like notes of ylang-ylang and orange blossom.

The base notes and dry down of the fragrance is a beautiful honey scent masked with musk, tonka beans, and a woody sandalwood/cedar mix that creates a long-lasting impression for the wearer that keeps you wanting more.

products.title: Kajal III Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Kajal III is a 100 ml eau de parfum with a sparkling lemon-soda and grapefruit opening, an aromatic heart and a warm, earthy base. Rosemary, neroli and lavender meet crisp ginger before ambroxan, patchouli, musk and amber unfold. Created to honour determination and fortitude, it pairs lively citrus freshness with grounded warmth.


From time to time in our lives, we encounter unanticipated hardships. The battle we face may be physical, it may be spiritual, it may be within ourselves.

We are not defined by our circumstances, but by how we choose to confront them. Bravery is not always a spectacular display of heroism. Sometimes, the strength to remain optimistic, the resolve to endeavor, and an ardent desire for life, are the most astonishing forms of courage of all.

Symbolically, three is a powerful number which holds great significance as it represents the wholeness of a completed cycle. The past, the present, the future. Encapsulating spirited vibrance, Kajal III has been meticulously created to honor all forms of determination and fortitude.


TOP NOTES

The top notes reveal a refreshing citrus burst of an effervescent lemon soda, intricately combined with bright and lively Grapefruit, a symbol of cleansing and purification

 

HEART NOTES 

The middle notes emerge with a calm, soothing union of Rosemary, Neroli and Lavender, flawlessly blended with crisp, spicy Ginger. In many cultures, Ginger is regarded as a symbol of strength and is believed to attract love and happiness.

 

BASE NOTES

As we reach the base notes, we discover a rich, earthy composition of Ambroxan, Patchouli and Musk, fused with a warm Amber sweetness. Formed through resilience, Amber represents courage, endurance, and wisdom.

products.title: Topaz by Kajal Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Topaz by Kajal is a 100 ml eau de parfum with a floral-woody character. Sparkling citrus and orange blossom meet rich floral and woody facets, echoing the warmth and connection at the heart of its friendship-inspired story.

Across the ages, ancient empires treasured Topaz, its radiant glow believed to reflect the strength of the sun, embracing the wearer in protective warmth.

Yet, Topaz was far more than a guardian gemstone, it stood as a profound symbol of connection and loyalty, a cherished gift that strengthened bonds and empowered relationships to endure with quiet, unshakable grace.

Topaz is a celebration of the love found in friendship, in all its depth and beauty. One of life’s most precious gifts is the presence of those who choose to walk beside us, kindred spirits who, like enduring embers, radiate comfort, and quiet strength through every season.

products.title: Kajal Kolada Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Kajal Kolada is a piña colada-inspired extrait de parfum in a 100 ml bottle, blending bright tropical fruit with creamy warmth. Pineapple and Italian bergamot open the fragrance, followed by violet and lily of the valley. Coconut milk, amber and Siamese benzoin bring a soft, warm finish, evoking the ease of a tropical escape.

 

Inspired by the iconic Pina Colada, Kajal Kolada pays homage to happiness, tranquility, and exoticism. The Pina Colada conjures visions of a lush, tropical paradise, where the emerald palm leaves of coconut groves gently sway as a blissfully balmy breeze caresses them, offering momentary respite from the sultry heat. Pristine ivory sands meet shimmering aquamarine waters, seamlessly blending into pastel-colored cotton candy skies as infinite as the hopes and dreams within us all.

While we may long for the euphoria of exploring distant horizons, let us not overlook the myriad of blessings that surround us in our everyday existence. When we choose to focus on being truly present in the moment, we become aware of the vast treasures that enrich our lives, allowing us to cherish what may seem to be the smallest of things. Practicing gratitude is among the most precious gifts we can bestow upon ourselves, as it leads us to the tranquil beauty of inner peace and contentment, a realm of happiness beyond compare.

Kolada opens with a delightfully vibrant burst of Italian Bergamot combined with fruity notes, including Pineapple, which symbolizes prosperity and friendship. 

The heart notes reveal the delicate sweetness of violet, exquisitely blended with the gentle freshness of Lily of the Valley, a flower believed by many to symbolize luck, happiness, and love. 

As Kolada unfurls, we are greeted with an exhilarating fusion of musky warmth from Amber and Siamese Benzoin, combined with the soft, exotic creaminess of coconut milk. Coconuts represent the unity of body, mind, and spirit, which must be in harmony for spiritual growth.

Kajal Kolada. 
Perfume meets paradise.

products.title: Ruby by Kajal Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Ruby by Kajal is a 100 ml eau de parfum with a fruity gourmand character. Red berries, coconut, almond, pineapple and cherries lead into whipped cream, soft powdery accents, ice cream and brown sugar. Musk, vanilla, amber, benzoin and tonka beans create a warm, creamy base, bringing a playful sweetness to this tribute to love.

Many ancient cultures revered rubies, believing an eternal flame burned at their very core, one that would never dim or fade, making them a timeless symbol of true love. In the whispered legends of antiquity, rubies were said to be the very lifeblood of Mother Earth, crystallized over millennia into fiery gems. These sacred stones became immortal emblems of love, vitality, and the unyielding pulse of life itself.

Ruby is a tribute to love in all its forms, romantic, familial, or platonic. In a world often shrouded in shadow, love's radiant glow remains constant, ever ready to illuminate and guide us.

Ruby opens with a burst of red berries, coconut, almond, pineapple, and juicy cherries. Much like cherry blossoms, cherries capture the delicate and fleeting nature of beauty and life, a reminder of moments that are too precious to last. The heart notes unfold in a delectable swirl of whipped cream, soft powdery accents, ice cream, and brown sugar, embodying warmth, and comfort. Finally, the base settles into a rich fusion of musk, vanilla, amber, benzoin, and Tonka beans, which are symbolic of love and sensuality.

products.title: Lamar Noir by Kajal Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Lamar Noir by Kajal is a 100 ml extrait de parfum opening with bergamot, green apple, fruity notes and violets. A balsamic heart blends vanilla and caramel with geranium, rose and floral notes, leading to a rich base of leather, oud, guaiac wood, sandalwood, cashmere, musk, amber, woody notes and moss. Its contrast of bright fruit and deep woods echoes a journey from darkness to light.

 

To embark on an odyssey of inner alchemy is one of life's most exquisitely challenging voyages. By navigating the raw, unrefined shadows within we can heal. Turning wounds into wisdom, and chaos into calm.

It takes immense courage to truly embrace the art of introspection, to confront our deepest fears and linger in the blackness of the night. Yet, by being patient enough, we can await the incomparable golden glow of illumination that guides us to serenity.

The transformative journey from darkness to light.

products.title: Äican by Kajal Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Äican by Kajal is a 100 ml eau de parfum with a fruity, spicy and warm scent profile. Inspired by gold purified of imperfections, the fragrance pairs its vibrant character with a story of optimism, renewal and inner radiance.


ÄICAN, a beautiful Arabic term of deep significance, represents gold that has been purified of all imperfections. A piece of gold may lie for years, concealed beneath layers of earth and stone, yet even through the darkness, its radiance is not diminished. Optimism, fortitude, and a tenacious desire for improvement can erode those layers of impurity, revealing a truly astonishing brilliance.

The power of positivity is ours to unleash. We all have the choice to embrace a new beginning and to shine once again, revealing the magnificence that has always resided within us.

We can. You can. ÄICAN.

ÄICAN was crafted from a passionate belief in the transformative power of optimism. It embodies an ardent aspiration to encapsulate the invigorating vibrance of positive energy into a fragrance.

products.title: Kajal IV Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Kajal IV is a 100 ml eau de parfum opening with davana, blackcurrant, rum and cardamom. Jasmine and palm flowers meet rich leather at the heart, while dates, vanilla, musk and woody notes create a warm, fruity base. Inspired by adventure and the African Savannah, Kajal IV brings together aromatic spice, floral sweetness and textured leather.

Infinite grains of sand form an undulating golden panorama, vast and untamed, blending harmoniously into spectacular glowing skies. Sun kissed skin shimmers, evocative of the celestial stars soon to emerge. The gentle caress of a sultry, aromatic breeze encapsulates the elation of adventure.

Our footprints may be a momentary reminder of our presence, but the memories we make last forever.

Kajal IV is a celebration of nomadic exoticism, echoing the wilderness of the African Savannah.

Spiritually, four represents calmness and balance, the stability of feeling connected to the present moment. It also symbolizes the wholeness of the universe, four elements, four seasons, four cardinal points, connecting us all.

products.title: Masa by Kajal Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Masa, the Arabic name for a singular diamond. If we had an eternity to sift through a sea of diamonds, we would never find two the same, they are renowned for their uniqueness as much as they are for their astonishing beauty. 

Diamonds represent resilience, eternal love, purity, and new beginnings. These enchanting attributes highlight the ambiguous elements of this gem’s invincibility and the inherent delicacy of the one who wears it. 

The Moon is a symbol of illumination, each Lunar phase is represented in the design of Masa in Silver, which is associated with strength, abundance, and enlightenment.

Masa embodies the precious luminosity of the diamond through a perfect balance of herbal freshness and ambered wood notes. Masa opens with a delicious combination of bergamot, Mirabelle and grapefruit highlighted by the warm spice of Ginger root. The heart notes consist of a fresh blend of Patchouli, Aquatic accord, Petitgrain and Cardamom. In the base, we find a wrapping mixture of Amber, Vanilla, Atlas Cedarwood, Vetiver, Guaiac Wood, and Violet which enhance the vivid radiance of the diamond within each bottle of Masa.

products.title: Almaz by Kajal Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Almaz by Kajal is a 100 ml eau de parfum combining bergamot and blackcurrant with a raspberry-floral heart. Heliotrope adds softness, while musk, woods, vanilla, amber and brown sugar create a warm, sweet base. Created by perfumer Rania Jouaneh, this fruity floral fragrance draws inspiration from the brilliance and enduring beauty of diamonds.

A beauty so enchanting, it has enraptured people for centuries. A clarity so pure, one glimpse is enough to mesmerize. A love so powerful, its eternal radiance will forever shine.

Treasured throughout history, precious gemstones have been sought after on many a quest. By far the most desired and cherished is the Almaz, a gem of legendary sparkling brilliance which symbolizes everlasting love, strength, and good health. Almaz, the Arabic name for diamonds, are renowned not only for their sublime beauty, but also for their timelessness as they withstand millions of years of immense pressure to form.

products.title: Faris by Kajal Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Faris by Kajal is a 100 ml eau de parfum combining sparkling citrus with aromatic lavender and juniper berries, a floral-spicy heart and a warm woody-amber base. Bergamot, lemon, orange and apple brighten the opening, while rose and jasmine meet coriander, nutmeg and clove at the heart. Amber, tonka bean, sandalwood, patchouli and vetiver bring depth to the base. Created by perfumers Urs Castelletti and David Chieze, Faris balances fresh aromatic notes with warm woods and spice.

Faris, an Arabic name embodying the noble spirit of a knight, fabled for valour and loyalty, reminds us that in a world consumed by the pursuit of material wealth, we must cherish the intrinsic virtues in life. We are all remembered for our character and the impact we have on others, and it is within our power to ensure that this influence is profound and uplifting.

True inner peace arises from a life faithfully lived with honesty and unwavering principles, where the courage to be authentic, the grace to act with dignity and discernment, and the humility to remain fair and just guide every step.

Palm leaves inspired the design of Faris, emblematic of resilience and longevity, flourishing even in the harshest environments. Silver was selected for its symbolism of purity and clarity, acting as a mirror to the soul and enabling us to perceive ourselves through the eyes of others.

Meticulously crafted by renowned perfumers Urs Castelletti and David Chieze, Faris opens with an invigorating combination of sparkling Bergamot, Lemon, Orange, Apple, Lavender, and Juniper berries, which represent protection. The heart notes bloom with an elegant fusion of Rose and Jasmine, enriched by the inviting warmth of Coriander, Nutmeg and Clove, renowned for its association with strength and courage. As the base notes unfold, they embrace us with a luxurious harmony of Amber, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood, Patchouli and Vetiver, often associated with grounding and stability due to its deep-rooted growth.

products.title: Lamar by Kajal Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Lamar by Kajal is a 100 ml eau de parfum with a luminous fruity-floral character and a warm woody-amber base. Created by perfumer Mark Buxton, it opens with pineapple, apple and red berries accented by cardamom and coriander. Jasmine Sambac, Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose and magnolia bloom at the heart, while vanilla, musk, amber, cashmere wood and cedar wood bring warmth and depth. Inspired by the glow of a golden sunset, Lamar pairs juicy fruit with sensual flowers and soft woods.

 

As skies vaster than we can comprehend unfold into a breathtaking panorama of luminous, glowing hues, we are bathed in the ethereal warmth of elation. Lamar was crafted to evoke the joy of being embraced by a mesmerising, golden sunset, as a gentle breeze carries upon it the sensual aroma of exotic flowers.

In Arabic, Lamar means Liquid Gold, a substance that was sought after for centuries by alchemists as they believed it to be the Elixir of Life, a legendary potion promising immortality. While eternity may be beyond our reach, we can choose to embrace the liberating joy of living in the exhilarating splendour of the present moment.

The most precious treasures of all, have always been within our grasp.

 

Created by world renowned perfumer, Mark Buxton, Lamar opens with a delectable combination of red berries, Apple, Cardamom, Coriander and Pineapple, which is celebrated in many cultures for representing friendship and prosperity. The heart notes appear with a sublime blend of Jasmine Sambac, Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose and Magnolia, which is cherished as a symbol of good luck and stability. As the base notes unfold, we are greeted with a deliciously warm concoction of Vanilla, Musk, Amber, Cashmere wood, and Cedar wood, which symbolises endurance, protection and purification.

 

“The strong vibrating woody base is a mixture of amber, cashmere and cedar wood, rounded off with musk, vanilla and moss. All in all, a unique diffusive creation.”

products.title: Sawlaj Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Sawlaj by Kajal is a 100 ml eau de parfum pairing bright Amalfi lemon with the velvety warmth of labdanum. Jasmine, rose and carnation unfold alongside leather and patchouli, before settling into vanilla, benzoin, vetiver and oakmoss. Inspired by raw silver, Sawlaj contrasts citrus freshness with a warm, textured floral-leather and mossy base.

 

Sawlaj is an Arabic phrase that signifies raw silver bullion, a precious metal embodying raw potential and timeless magnetism. The untamed beauty of raw silver whispers tales of untold fortunes, patiently awaiting the touch of discovery to unveil its true, luminous splendor. Sawlaj is an ode to those on a continuous quest for self-discovery, never fearing what introspection may reveal but embracing the opportunity to improve. Silver, in its spiritual essence, acts as a mirror to our souls, reflecting the light of our innermost being. It is in the unveiling of our hidden treasures that our true brilliance emerges. 

 

Sawlaj opens with an enigmatic blend of Labdanum’s velvety warmth and the invigorating freshness of Amalfi Lemon and Lemon. Spiritually, Lemon represents purity, clarity, and simplicity.

 

The heart notes emerge with an intoxicating embrace of Jasmine, Rose, Carnation, Leather, and Patchouli, which is known to represent wealth, prosperity, grounding, and spiritual evolution.

 

As the base notes progress, they reveal a profoundly comforting fusion of Vanilla, Benzoin, Vetiver and Oakmoss. Rich in symbolism, Oakmoss is celebrated for sensuality, wisdom, healing, and endurance. 

 

Sawlaj, the epitome of captivating elegance and magnetic allure.

products.title: Warek Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Warek is a 100 ml eau de parfum opening with saffron and incense, followed by a rich heart of rose, patchouli, amber and guaiac wood. Vanilla, leather and oud form a deep, warm base. Inspired by silver transformed under pressure, Warek pairs smoky spice with textured woods and supple leather.

 

Warek, an Arabic ode to history, captures the allure of meticulously hammered and flattened silver coins, each a symbol of astonishing fortitude. As Silver endures each relentlessly forceful strike, it is stretched and thinned to the brink of fragility. It may relinquish its former shape, but it emerges more magnificent, shining with unparalleled clarity. This exquisite metamorphosis serves as a poignant metaphor for resilience and rebirth. It reminds us that the trials and hardships we endure do not diminish our essence; rather, they reveal our true strength, purpose, and beauty. 

Warek opens with an earthy and ethereal blend of Saffron and Incense. Saffron was chosen for its known properties to increase inner peace and enhance emotional healing.

As the heart notes emerge, we discover an enticing fusion of Rose, Patchouli, Amber, and Guaiac Wood, each associated with promoting positive energies.

The base notes reveal a captivating unity of sumptuous Vanilla, the timeless elegance of rich Leather, and the mystifying allure of Oud. 

 

Warek, ignite your inner resilience, unveil your radiant essence.

products.title: Sareef Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Sareef is a 100 ml eau de parfum with a bright citrus-juniper opening, a spicy leather-and-cedar heart, and a warm woody base. Bergamot and lemon bring crisp freshness before estragol, nutmeg and cashmeran unfold. Oud, amber, patchouli, vanilla and vetiver add depth to this fragrance inspired by the enduring radiance of pure silver.

 

Sareef, a term of Arabic origin, distinctly signifies 'pure silver,' encapsulating both clarity and refined sophistication. Pure silver, renowned for its steadfast sheen and authenticity, epitomizes grace under pressure, a perfect parallel to the individual who reflects these endearing qualities. Their character, resplendent with integrity, casts a light that pierces through obscurity, revealing the world in its truest form. Enduring, much like silver, this person's radiance and worth only deepen over time, remaining untainted by life's relentless trials. Just as silver enchants its surroundings, they emanate an aura of pure, unwavering authenticity, etching in the hearts of others an indelible mark of brilliance and resolute strength. 

 

Sareef opens with an invigorating blend of Bergamot and Lemon, infused with the aromatic, crisp coolness of Juniper, which is renowned for evoking healing, strength, and stability.

 

As the heart notes unfold, we discover a deliciously warm and spicy fusion of Estragol, Nutmeg, Cashmeran, Leather and Cedar- which symbolizes prosperity and abundance.

 

The base notes embrace us with a delectable combination of Oud, Amber, Patchouli, Vanilla, and Vetiver. Spiritually, Vetiver represents growth and transformation, a fitting tribute to the evolving spirit of the Sareef gentleman, constantly seeking to transcend the ordinary.

products.title: Fiddah Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Fiddah is a 100 ml eau de parfum combining bright bergamot and warm spice with a leather-tobacco heart. Floral and fruity notes meet star anise and cinnamon at the opening, while amber, tonka beans, benzoin, vanilla and musk create a warm, enveloping base. Inspired by the shimmer of silver, Fiddah balances aromatic brightness with rich, textured depth.

 

 

Fiddah, an Arabic word, represents silver in both hue and substance. Silver's ethereal shimmer, embodying the essence of receptivity, mirrors a serene harmony of inner wisdom. Revered for its resplendent glow, akin to the moon, it serves as a spiritual compass, masterfully blending feminine intuition with masculine logic. These attributes, deep emotional resonance, intellectual balance, and a captivating aura of mystery, are not just compelling but irresistibly attractive, lending silver a magnetic allure that transcends the ordinary. 

Designed for the warm-hearted and passionate, Fiddah envelops you in a seductive embrace. It unfurls with a burst of bergamot, flowery notes, star anise, fruity notes, and cinnamon – the latter exuding a warm, invigorating presence, infused with masculine energy that kindles action, strength, and motivation. At its heart, leather and tobacco notes evoke a luxurious ruggedness – grounded yet enigmatic. As the base notes ascend, a delectable blend of amber, tonka beans, benzoin, vanilla, and musk unveils itself. 

Fiddah, a captivating aroma that embodies strength, virility, and an enigmatic allure.

products.title: Wardé by Kajal Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Wardé by Kajal is a 100 ml eau de parfum combining a green, aromatic opening with abundant florals and a rich oud-balsamic base. Absinthe, armoise, pine and blackcurrant lead into white flowers, jasmine, orange blossom, violet and rose. Fir balsam, moss and patchouli bring woodland depth beneath the bouquet, softened by sweet balsamic notes.

 

Wardé is a flower that gives; generous as all flowers are. Wardé is a reflection of the beauty of abundance, prosperity, and richness.

Because flowers play an important part of our everyday life, we wanted the fragrance that holds the name of the collection “Wardé” to embody this role. If you take a look around you, you will find flowers available in one form or another, whether it’s an art piece, a design on a print, carpet, cutlery, clothes, linen, buildings… The list is endless. After working alongside renowned French perfumer Alix Miral, Wardé was created.

Experiencing the fragrance, you are immediately taken in with the richness of the notes. A dark and hypnotic absinthe in the top is lifted in freshness by the use of armoise, pine and a deep black currant note.

The heart of Wardé inspires a combination of white flowers, jasmine, orange blossom, violet and rose amongst the   notes, working in unison to deliver the flowery concoction. Oud in the base – combined with the green-ness of fir balsam, moss, and patchouli – pairs with the sweetness of balsamic notes to give Wardé its long-lasting appeal.

products.title: Jihan by Kajal Eau de Parfum 100 ml
products.body_html:
Jihan by Kajal is a 100 ml eau de parfum blending saffron and apple blossom with a spicy floral heart of cloves, magnolia and rose. Vanilla, oud, musk, sandalwood and patchouli create a rich, rounded base. Inspired by the crocus flower and its precious saffron threads, Jihan brings floral softness and warm spice together.

 

Jihan, the Arabic name given to the beautiful crocus flower, is symbolic of cheerfulness, joy, youthfulness, and glee. The flower appears at the first sign of spring. The Jihan flower can be found in white, purple, and yellow. The purple Jihan is the most prized, and it reflects pride, dignity, and success.

But it is the sacrificial aspect of Jihan that has captivated people for centuries: giving up something beautiful and valued for the sake of something else. The Jihan flower is sacrificed to give the famous threads that are used worldwide in cooking: saffron, one of the most expensive spices of the world.

"When we were creating our signature Jihan fragrance – working with Drom’s perfumer, Valerie Garnuch-Mentzel – I was taken back to my early days admiring the cooking skills of my mother in the kitchen. I especially remember the cabinet that used to house the little sacred jar of saffron… I always used to feel as if the jar contained a sprinkle of magic – a pretty little pot that housed the rich red threads. I would watch with awe as my mother would infuse the aromatic rose water with saffron, and I would sit amazed as the saffron steeped and the water became a dynamic reddish/yellow hue." Moe Khalaf (Founder & Kajal Creative Officer).

This is the scent of Jihan – it opens up with a unique saffron/apple-blossom combination that seduces the senses. But like the characteristic of the Jihan flower, the richness is sacrificed for something greater. The seductive excitement is infused with heart notes of cloves, magnolia, and rose that gently pacify the wearer. The generosity of the fragrance is deeply felt – rich and giving.  In the base, beautiful vanilla, oud, musk, and sandalwood touched with patchouli give wholeness to the fragrance and round it off perfectly.
